name: Recycling
highLevelGoals: The User aims to quickly and easily find nearby recycling facilities based on their location or specific search criteria.
The User seeks to view detailed information about recycling facilities, including operational hours, accepted materials, and contact details.
The User desires to be informed about upcoming recycling events, special waste drop-off sites, and other relevant community initiatives.
The User wants to personalize their experience by saving favorite facilities, tracking their recycling activities, and receiving tailored recommendations.
The User aims to schedule flexible pickup times and receive recommendations for recycling centers that fit their weekly schedule and waste types.
The Administrator aims to maintain up-to-date and accurate information for all listed recycling facilities to provide reliable data to users.
The Administrator seeks to efficiently review, categorize, and respond to user feedback, complaints, and questions to improve the service.
The Administrator aims to establish and maintain clear communication channels with recycling facility representatives to coordinate updates and address issues.
The Facility Representative aims to ensure that their facility's information, including operational hours and accepted materials, is always accurate and up-to-date on the platform.
The Facility Representative seeks to have a direct and efficient way to communicate any issues, concerns, or updates to the site administrators.
The Superuser aims to promptly update recycling center information to provide users with the most current and reliable data.
The Superuser seeks to efficiently answer user questions related to recycling centers, ensuring users receive helpful and correct information.
lowLevelGoals: The User can input a zip code to receive a filtered list of recycling facilities within that area.
The User can input a material type (e.g., 'plastic bottles', 'electronics') to find facilities that accept that specific material.
The User can apply a filter to display only facilities that are open during specific hours or on certain days.
The User can view a list of publicly accessible recycling bins on a map or in a list format.
The User can view a list of locations designated for special waste drop-off (e.g., hazardous waste, electronics).
The User can view the location of recycling facilities on an interactive map interface.
The User can click on a facility's address to open it in an external map application (e.g., Google Maps) for navigation.
The User can select a facility to see its complete schedule, including daily opening and closing times.
The User can view a comprehensive list of all materials that a chosen recycling facility accepts.
The User can find and utilize the provided contact details to get in touch with a specific recycling facility.
The User can opt-in to receive alerts about new recycling events in their area.
The User can configure their notification settings to only receive alerts for events related to certain types of waste.
The User can register for a new account by providing necessary personal details.
The User can link their email address to their profile to enable password recovery options.
The User can mark a facility as a favorite for quick access in the future.
The User can record their recycling efforts, including what they recycled, where, and when.
The system will suggest facilities or events to the User based on their previously logged recycling activities.
The User can exchange accumulated reward points for various benefits or discounts.
The User can submit feedback, suggestions, or complaints directly to the system administrators.
The User can select a preferred date and time window for a recycling pickup service for certain materials.
The system will suggest optimal recycling centers and times for the User based on their availability and the materials they need to recycle.
The User can confirm their chosen time slot for a recycling drop-off or pickup.
The Administrator can input all necessary details for a new recycling facility, including location, contact, and operational hours.
The Administrator can modify any detail of an already listed facility, such as changing operational hours or accepted materials.
The Administrator can delete a facility's entry if it is no longer operational or relevant.
The Administrator can access a centralized list of all feedback, complaints, and inquiries submitted by users.
The Administrator can assign a category to each piece of feedback to help with organization and prioritization.
The Administrator can compose and send a reply to a specific user regarding their submitted feedback.
The Administrator can retrieve the contact information (email, phone) for representatives of each listed recycling facility.
The Administrator can initiate communication with a facility representative through the system's messaging or email integration.
The Administrator can record details of interactions with facility representatives for future reference.
The Facility Representative can modify the opening and closing times for their recycling center.
The Facility Representative can add or remove materials that their facility accepts for recycling.
The Facility Representative can change the phone number, email, or website associated with their facility.
The Facility Representative can use an in-app messaging system to report problems or concerns to the administrators.
The Facility Representative can submit changes to their facility's details for review and approval by the administrators.
The Facility Representative will get alerts from administrators regarding important system information or changes.
The Superuser can make immediate changes to any recycling center's details and have them reflected on the platform instantly.
The Superuser can review proposed changes from Facility Representatives and decide whether to publish them.
The Superuser has the authority to replace current facility details with updated information, ensuring accuracy.
The Superuser can view a list of all user inquiries that are awaiting a response.
The Superuser can write and send a personalized answer to a specific user inquiry.
The Superuser can change the status of a user inquiry to indicate that it has been addressed.
